Leaker Evan Blass has just posted that iPhone Ultra will come in three colours, including a surprising red option.

Update: Mark Gurman has posted on X that iPhone Ultra will not come in red, directly contradicting Blass. Original story below.

Evan Blass claims iPhone Ultra could come in red

With the iPhone launch event officially set for September 9, rumours about Apple's next flagship iPhone keep rolling in. The latest concerns the colours for the foldable iPhone Ultra.

It's already widely expected that the iPhone 18 Pro will come in a bold deep cherry/wine red, a light blue, silver, and possibly space grey.

However, rumours have suggested that iPhone Ultra might come in only black and white, or possibly white only.

But leaker Evan Blass has now posted on X claiming there will also be a red version.

The image above appears to be AI-generated. For one thing, the iOS 27 status bar doesn't line up, using the older iOS 26 battery icon design.

However, the image is likely AI-generated, which doesn't necessarily mean the colour information is wrong.

We're sceptical here, as we've never seen a credible rumour before that iPhone Ultra would come in red. It also seems unusual for both flagship models to offer a red option. So treat this rumour with caution.

Either way, we'll find out what Apple has prepared in two weeks.

What do you think of the rumoured iPhone Ultra colours? Let us know in the comments.
